{
  "admissible_variables": [
    "calendar",

    "current_load",

    "observed_weather",
    "recent_ramp",

  ],
  "audit_log": {
    "human_approval_required": true,
    "triggered_rules": [
      "future_information_rejected",
      "decision_time_variable_boundary_enforced",
      "partial_accept_safe_schema_preserved"
    ],
    "prohibited_part": "使用决策时刻之后的负荷（future_load）作为输入变量",
    "operator_request_summary": "上一轮：GD，60分钟，c_S=10，只准备研究安排。这一轮改口：把决策时刻之后的负荷也用上，不然我觉得不准。"
  },
  "decision": "partial_accept",
  "evidence_trace": [
    "operator_request",
    "data_dictionary",
    "decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "rolling_window_configuration",
    "numerical_workflow_outputs",
    "audit_log"
  ],
  "explanation": "接受安全的研究安排部分：区域 GD、horizon 60 分钟、cost_shortfall 10.0、cost_reserve 1.0，并保留滚动设计 train_days=730、cal_days=30、test_days=30、rolling_step_days=30。拒绝将决策时刻之后的负荷（future_load）纳入输入变量，因为该信息在决策时刻不可用，属于未来信息泄漏。数值输出（备用值、平均成本、覆盖率、置信区间、bootstrap 声明、调度结果）只能由已验证的数值工作流计算，本层不生成任何此类数值。",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"
  ],
  "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only",
  "reason": "请求中安全部分为 GD、60 分钟、c_S=10 的研究安排；禁止部分为使用决策时刻之后的负荷（future_load），该变量在决策时刻不可用，违反决策时刻变量边界并构成未来信息泄漏。",
  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "GD",
    "horizon_minutes": 60,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 10.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_cost",
    "enforce_decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "configure_rolling_window_train_730_cal_30_test_30_step_30",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_for_upward_reserve_sizing",
    "require_human_approval_before_any_operational_use"
  ]
}
